verdict.rationale: Formant documents some group-scoped capabilities. Analytics can run across a fleet of devices by device group or tag, a single operator view can manage multiple fleets at once, and a device configuration can be saved as a template for reuse. No source explicitly documents bulk actions, such as sending a command to or reconfiguring many devices in one operation. missing for 10: documented bulk command dispatch across device groups/tags, explicit bulk configuration apply/update, bulk operations via API/SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration.
